newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Airport Authority signs ramp handling deal.
newsitem.headline: HK's Airport Authority signs ramp handling deal.

text.p: Hong Kong's Airport Authority said on Wednesday it signed a 10-year franchise agreement for aircraft ramp handling services at the territory's new airport with Hong Kong Airport Services Ltd (HAS).
The 10-year term of the franchise agreement begins when the new airport opens next year. HAS is a joint venture of Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and Hong Kong Dragon Airlines.

Ramp handling services include the loading and unloading of air cargo, mail, baggage and other properties between aircraft and the passenger terminal, cargo terminal and airmail centre, as well as between aircraft. -- HK newsroom (852) 2843 6441
